# dreamformula.com

> Personal and professional website for Joe Shindelar, a developer educator, Drupal contributor, speaker, writer, and internet nerd in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

This site includes background information, selected work, speaking highlights, writing, and links to Joe Shindelar's public profiles.
